description: Cold TLS handshake latency. Primary metric: TLS handshake duration (crypto cost). Secondary: compare H2+TLS vs H3/QUIC handshake latency (H3 pending toolchain). Linked to P2-02 D3 Community Loopback Handshake Benchmark.
loopback_caveat: TLS handshake loopback measurements reflect crypto + kernel cost without network RTT. Results are NOT comparable to measurements with network path. transport_mode=loopback-h2-tls is mandatory in all result artifacts.

tls.session_resumption_note: Session resumption MUST be disabled to ensure cold handshake measurement.

h2-tls.note: RSA-2048 self-signed cert via certs.sh. k6 insecureSkipTLSVerify=true for test cert.

h3-quic.reason: H3/QUIC handshake (0-RTT vs 1-RTT QUIC crypto) requires dedicated QUIC toolchain. No confirmed driver in runtime/drivers.

comparison_axis_note: H1-TLS vs H2-TLS handshake comparison requires same cert, same key type, and same session-resumption setting. Do not compare RSA-2048 to EC P-256 without explicit key-type caveat.
